items.title: Insurance payouts complicated as vehicles damaged in Bhotekoshi floods remain missing
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 27 Legal and technical complications have emerged in the insurance claim process for vehicles swept away by the devastating Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi floods, as their physical remains have not been recovered. items.title: Bhotekoshi flood victims may get up to Rs800,000 for new homes
items.summary: The government plans to provide one-time housing grants based on geographical regions, while families who lost their land will be included in an integrated housing programme.

items.title: Where the August floods began
items.summary: A massive ice and rock avalanche from Langtang Lirung plunged into the Lhende river on August 26, triggering devastating floods that swept through Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading.
